verdict.rationale: Pipedrive documents a public REST API in first-party docs. That includes v1 and v2 APIs with downloadable OpenAPI 3 specs, token and OAuth 2.0 authentication, per-endpoint rate-limit costs, and concrete endpoints for deals, leads, persons and organizations. It also provides an official NodeJS client, a developer sandbox, and programmatic webhook creation, so the API can drive the product end to end. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use; the community items do not cover the API, and a machine-readable markdown version of the docs returned 404.
